Comm’l Doc: SAE ARP-1070 DoD/MIL Doc: JSSG-2009 Appendix A: A.3.4.1.4.4.1/A.4.4.1.4.4.1 Braking control interface MIL-B-8584 Design of Brake Systems AFGS-87139: 3.2.3.2 Brake actuation system; 3.2.3.3 Anti-skid brake control; and 3.2.4.3 Brakes

Criterion: Verify that when brake command is removed, brakes return to brakes-off position and brake control power is not trapped or slow to release any brake. Standard: When the input braking command is removed, the brake actuation system returns to a free-wheeling position to prevent any dragging brake events from occurring. Brake heat stack running clearances and consistent brake on pressure levels are maintained. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include tests and demonstrations. Laboratory testing verifies that brakes are released and running clearances are maintained when input commands are removed. Air vehicle checkout verifies system operation and integration. Ground and flight braking tests verify performance. References: JSSG-2009: A.3.4.1.4.4.1, A.4.4.1.4.4.1 Braking control interface MIL-B-8584 AFGS-87139: 3.2.3.2 Brake actuation system; 3.2.3.3 Anti-skid brake control; 3.2.4.3 Brakes SAE ARP1070

Standard: The braking system prevents a dragging brake condition. When input braking command is removed, the brake actuation system returns to the brakes off position. The brakes release time prevents heat buildup of brake stack or skidding of the tire. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: Conduct lab testing to verify that brake pressure or clamping force is removed and running clearances are maintained when input commands are removed. Brake system response prevents dragging brakes.
(2) Ground test: Conduct ground test to verify that brake pressure or clamping force is removed when brake command is removed. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
(3) Flight test: Conduct flight test to verify that brake pressure or clamping force is removed when brake command is removed.
